title: 1994 Classic #1 Emmitt Smith Dallas Cowboys Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 1994 Classic Pro Line trading card features the legendary Emmitt Smith, who played for the Dallas Cowboys. It is a highly sought-after card for collectors of football memorabilia. The card is part of the Sports Trading Card category and is a great addition to any sports fan's collection. The card number is #1 and it is from the 1994 season.
